completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 18
G.N. No. S 589/1998
REVISED EDITION 2000
(31st January 2000)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 1st December1998:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 15th December 1998, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
(1) The Apportionment Act (Chapter 8).
(2) The Apportionment of Rents Act (Chapter 9).
(3) The Computer Misuse Act (Chapter 50A)
(4) The Films Act (Chapter 107)
(5) The Local Forces (Relief of Financial Hardship) Act (Chapter 165)
(6) The Misuse of Drugs Act (Chapter 185)
(7) The Planning Act (Chapter 232)
(8) The Small Claims Tribunals Act (Chapter 308)
(9) The Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Act (Chapter 310)
(10) The Statutory Bodies and Government Companies (Protection of Secrecy) Act (Chapter 319)
(11) The Statutory Corporations (Contributions to Consolidated Fund) Act (Chapter 319A)
(12) The Undesirable Publications Act (Chapter 338)
(13) The Workmen’s Compensation Act (Chapter 354)
[G.N. No.S 589/98]
